Boundaries.Name: download-payload-read
Boundaries.Contract: Once GET returns a stream, each public payload read is a separate logical caller. Preserve stream cancellation, pipe drain and receive ordering; do not hold GET ownership forever.

Boundaries.Name: download-payload-array-read
Boundaries.Contract: A synchronous read owns its observed failure. Repeated reads of a failed payload publish once; invalid arguments do not count.

Boundaries.Name: download-payload-span-read
Boundaries.Contract: Span reads preserve failure identity and acquire observation storage only on failure.

Boundaries.Name: download-payload-byte-read
Boundaries.Contract: A byte read shares the payload failure publication boundary with all other read overloads.

Boundaries.Name: download-payload-legacy-read
Boundaries.Contract: Individual read cancellation preserves its token/status without hiding a later payload failure. Both failures use copied completed header retry attempts.
